topics.label: Lecture introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and frames the study of complement and its nomenclature.

topics.label: Fundamentals and core activation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the fundamental architecture, nomenclature, and central C3 biochemical activation of the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the upstream recognition pathways that converge to generate C3 convertase on target surfaces.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream effector functions triggered by complement activation to eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and proteins that protect host cells from accidental complement attack.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the pathological consequences and disease phenotypes resulting from deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the molecular strategies used by pathogens to evade complement-mediated destruction, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture on complement and previews the upcoming topic in the lecture series.
